title: Where did I put my water bottle? I forgot.
scene: 水壶不知放哪了，问爸爸看见没。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Where did I put my water bottle? I forgot.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you remember to bring it inside the house?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Did you see it sitting in the car?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I think I did, it was on the seat.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay, I will go out and check the car.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: While you're there, can you bring mine too?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Maybe I will, if I can find mine first.

variations: "water bottle" 换 "jacket"；"in the car" 换 "by the door"。
